properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Former nursing home, unoccupied since earlier closure of the facility. Potential scope for conversion to residential units and/or part demolition and new-build. Permission granted for alteration to provide 7 flats (16/00935/FUL). The units will be provided by conversion of a number of existing buildings, across three sections of the site, including the main building, an off-shoot to the south and a separate detached building to the east. Development of 7 dwellings completed in 2019/20.
